onset.Description: Intended onset of the stimulus, relative to the start of the run.

duration.Description: Intended on-screen duration of the scene (duplicate of stim_dur).

trial_type.Description: Constant label; the scene-exposure task has no experimental conditions, only passive viewing of each critical scene.

stim_file.Description: Path to the displayed scene image, relative to /stimuli/.

stim_name.Description: Base stimulus identifier for the presented scene.

stim_exemplar.Description: Exemplar number (1 or 2) distinguishing pairmates within a scene category.

target_eccen.Description: Eccentricity (degrees of visual angle) of the studied target/competitor locations; fixed at 3.3.

next_target_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of the target location associated with this scene (to be learned in the subsequent study/test blocks). Column name retains the 'next_' prefix used in the shared data-logging code across tasks, but here it refers to this scene's own eventual target location, not an upcoming trial (unlike in task-search). Scenes are shown without any location information during exposure.

next_target_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_target_ang.

next_target_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_target_ang.

next_comp_ang.Description: Polar angle (degrees) of the competitor location associated with this scene (i.e., the target location of this scene's pairmate). See next_target_ang note on naming.

next_comp_x.Description: Cartesian x-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_comp_ang.

next_comp_y.Description: Cartesian y-coordinate (degrees of visual angle) corresponding to next_comp_ang.

next_targ_comp_dist.Description: Angular distance (degrees) between this scene's target and competitor locations.

run.Description: Run number, as recorded in the source data file.

run_type.Description: Constant label identifying this as a scene-exposure trial (duplicate of trial_type).

stim_dur.Description: Intended scene presentation duration (duplicate of duration).

stim_onset.Description: Measured (actual, not intended) onset of scene presentation. Recorded for QA purposes to confirm presentation timing.

stim_offset.Description: Measured (actual) offset of scene presentation. Recorded for QA purposes only.
